arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاكْسِرْ شَهْوَتِي عَنْ كُـلِّ مَحْرَم، وَازْوِ حِـرْصِي عَنْ كُلِّ مَأثَم، وَامْنَعْنِي عَنْ أَذَى كُـلِّ مُؤْمِن وَمُؤْمِنَـة وَمُسْلِم وَمُسْلِمَة،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa khsir shahwati ʿan kulli mahram wa azwī ḥirsī ʿan kulli mātham wa-amnaʿni ʿan adha kulli muʾminin wa muʾminatin wa muslimin wa muslima
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, break my passion for every unlawful thing, take away my craving for any sin, and bar me from harming any believer, male or female, and any Muslim, male or female!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا عَبْد نالَ مِنِّي مَا حَظَرْتَ عَلَيْهِ، وَانْتَهَكَ مِنِّي مَا حَجَرْتَ عَلَيْهِ، فَمَضَى بِظُلاَمَتِي مَيِّتاً، أَوْ حَصَلَتْ لِيْ قِبَلَهُ حَيّاً،
transliteration: allāhumma wa ayyuma ʿabdin nāla minnī mā ḥaẓarta ʿalayhi wa-antahaka minni maa hajar-ta ʿalayhi famadha biẓulamati mayyitan aw ḥaṣalat lī qibalahu ḥayyan
english_text: O God, if any of Thy servants should harm me in what Thou hast forbidden or violate me in what Thou hast interdicted, and if he should pass into death with my complaint or I come to have a complaint against him while he is alive,

arabic_text: فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ مَا أَلَمَّ بِهِ مِنِّي، وَاعْفُ لَهُ عَمَّا أَدْبَرَ بِهِ عَنِّي،
transliteration: faghfir lahu ma alamma bihi minni waʿfu lahu ʿammā adbara bihi ʿannī
english_text: forgive him what he did to me and pardon him that through which he turned his back on me!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَقِفْـهُ عَلَى مَا ارْتَكَبَ فِيَّ، وَلاَ تَكْشِفْهُ عَمَّا اكْتَسَبَ بِيْ،
transliteration: walā taqifhū ʿalā mā irtakaba fīy wala takshifhu ʿamma-aktasaba biy
english_text: Inquire not from him about what he committed toward me and expose him not through what he earned by me!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ مَا سَمَحْتُ بِهِ مِنَ الْعَفْـوِ عَنْهُمْ وَتَبَرَّعْتُ بِـهِ مِنَ الصَّدَقَةِ عَلَيْهِمْ أَزْكَى صَدَقَاتِ الْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَأَعْلَى صِلاَتِ الْمُتَقَرِّبِينَ،
transliteration: wa-jʿal mā samaḥtu bihi min al-ʿafwi ʿanhum wa tabarratʿtu bihi mina al-ṣadaqati ʿalayhim ʾazkā ṣadaqāt al-mutaṣaddiqīn wa'aʿlaa ṣalāt al-mutaqarrabīn
english_text: Make my open-handedness in pardoning such servants and my contribution in charity toward them the purest charity of the charitable and the highest gift of those seeking nearness to Thee!

arabic_text: وَعَوِّضْنِي مِنْ عَفْوِي عَنْهُمْ عَفْوَكَ وَمِنْ دُعَائِي لَهُمْ رَحْمَتَكَ حَتَّى يَسْعَدَ كُلُّ وَاحِد مِنَّا بِفَضْلِكَ وَيَنْجُوَ كُلٌّ مِنَّا بِمَنِّكَ.
transliteration: wa ʿawwidhni min ʿafwi ʿanhum ʿafwaka wa min du'āʾī lahum raḥmataka ḥattā yasʿada kullu wāḥidin minnā bifadlika wayanjū kullun minnā bimannika
english_text: Recompense me for my pardoning them with Thy pardon and for my supplicating for them with Thy mercy so that each one of us may gain felicity through Thy bounty and each may attain deliverance through Thy kindness!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّما عَبْد مِنْ عَبِيْدِكَ أدرَكَهُ مِنِّي دَرَكٌ أَوْ مَسَّهُ مِنْ نَاحِيَتِي أَذَىً، أَوْ لَحِقَـهُ بِي أَوْ بِسَبَبي ظُلْمٌ فَفُتُّهُ بِحَقِّـهِ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa-ayyuma ʿabd min ʿibādik ʾadrakah minnī darakun aw massahū min nāḥiyatī ʾaẓāan aw lahiqahu biyy aw bisababi dhulmun fafuttuhu bihaqqihi
english_text: O God, if there is a servant from among Thy servants whom an ill visits on my account, a harm touches from my direction, or a wrong overtakes through me or because of me, and should I fail to take care of his right

arabic_text: أَوْسَبَقْتُهُ بِمَظْلَمَتِهِ، فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَأَرْضِهِ عَنِّي مِنْ وُجْدِكَ، وَأَوْفِهِ حَقَّهُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ،
transliteration: ʾawsabaqtu-hu bi-maẓlamati-hi fa ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-arḍihi ʿannī min wujdika, wa-awfihu ḥaqqahu min ʿindika
english_text: or go before him [in death] with his complaint, bless Muhammad and his Household, satisfy him toward me through Thy wealth, and give him his full right from Thyself!

arabic_text: ثُمَّ قِنيْ مَا يُوجِبُ لَهُ حُكْمُكَ، وَخَلِّصْنِي مِمَّا يَحْكُمُ بِهِ عَدْلُكَ، فَإنَّ قُوَّتِي لا تَسْتَقِلُّ بِنَقِمَتِكَ، وَإنَّ طَاقتِي لا تَنْهَضُ بِسُخْطِكَ،
transliteration: thumma qinī mā yūjibuhu ḥukmuka wa khalliṣnī mimma yahkumu bihi ʿadluka fa'inna quwwati la tastaqillu binagimatika wa'innataqatī lā tanhadhu bisukhtika
english_text: Then protect me from what Thy decision mandates and save me from what Thy justice decides, for my strength cannot bear Thy vengeance and my power cannot stand up to Thy displeasure!

arabic_text: فَإنَّكَ إنْ تُكَـافِنِي بِالْحَقِّ تُهْلِكْنِي، وَإلاّ تَغَمَّـدْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ تُوبِقْنِي.
transliteration: fa'innaka in tukafini bilhaqqi tuhlíkni wa-illā taghammadnī birahmatika tūbiq-nī
english_text: If Thou recompensest me with the right, Thou wilt destroy me, and if Thou dost not shield me in Thy mercy, Thou wilt lay me waste.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إلهِي مَا لا يَنْقُصُكَ بَذْلُهُ، وَأَسْتَحْمِلُكَ مَا لا يَبْهَظُكَ حَمْلُهُ، أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إلهِي نَفْسِيَ الَّتِيْ لَمْ تَخْلُقْهَا لِتَمْتَنِعَ بِهَا مِنْ سُوء، أَوْ لِتَطَرَّقَ بِهَا إلى نَفْع،
transliteration: allāhumma innī astawhibuka yā ilāhī mā lā yanqusuka badluhu wa-astahmiluka ma la yabhathuka hamluhu astauhibuka ya ilahi nafsiya allati lam takhlukha litamtani'a biha min su' aw litatarraq biha ila nafʿ
english_text: O God, I ask Thee to grant, my God, that whose giving will not decrease Thee, and I ask Thee to carry that whose carrying will not weigh Thee down: My God, I ask Thee to give my soul, which Thou didst not create to keep Thyself from evil nor to find the way to profit.

arabic_text: وَلكِنْ أَنْشَأتَهَا إثْبَاتاً لِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى مِثْلِهَا، وَاحْتِجَاجاً بِهَا عَلَى شَكْلِهَا،
transliteration: walakin ansha'tahā ithbātan liqudrati-ka 'alā mithli-hā waḥtiǧājan bihā ʿalā shaklihā
english_text: No, Thou brought it forth to demonstrate Thy power over its like and to provide an argument against its similar.

arabic_text: وَأَسْتَحْمِلُكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ، وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَى مَا قَدْ فَدَحَنِي ثِقْلُهُ.
transliteration: wa-astahmiluka min dhunubi ma qad bahazhani hamluhu wa astaʿīnu bika ʿalā mā qad fadaḥanī thiqluhu
english_text: I ask Thee to carry those of my sins whose carrying weighs me down and I seek help from Thee in that whose heaviness oppresses me.

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَهَبْ لِنَفْسِي عَلَى ظُلْمِهَا نَفْسِيْ، وَوَكِّلْ رَحْمَتَكَ بِاحْتِمَالِ إصْرِي،
transliteration: faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wahab li nafsi ʿala ẓulmiha nafsi wa wakkill raḥmataka bi-iḥtimāli iṣrī
english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household, give to me my soul in spite of its wrongdoing, and appoint Thy mercy to carry my burden!

arabic_text: فَكَمْ قَدْ لَحِقَتْ رَحْمَتُكَ بِالْمُسِيئِينَ،
transliteration: fakam qad lahiqat rahmatuka bil musii'in
english_text: How many evildoers Thy mercy has overtaken!

arabic_text: وَكَمْ قَدْ شَمِلَ عَفْوُكَ الظَّالِمِينَ.
transliteration: wa kam qad shamilafu ka al-thalimeen
english_text: How many wrongdoers Thy pardon has embraced!

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَاجْعَلْنِي أُسْوَةَ مَنْ قَدْ أَنْهَضْتَهُ بِتَجَاوُزِكَ عَنْ مَصَارِعِ الْخَاطِئِينَ، وَخَلَّصْتَهُ بِتَوْفِيقِكَ مِنْ وَرَطَاتِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ، فَأَصْبَحَ طَلِيقَ عَفْوِكَ مِنْ إسَارِ سُخْطِكَ،
transliteration: fa sallī ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi, wajʿalnī uswatam man qad anhadtahu. bi-tajāwuzika ʿan maṣāriʿi l-khāṭiʾīn wa khallass-tahu bi tawfiqika min warataatil mujrimeen fa-asbaha ṭalīqa ʿafwik mni iṣāri sukḥtik
english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household and make me the model of him whom Thou hast aroused through Thy forbearance from the deadly infirmities of the offenders and saved through Thy giving success from the tangled plights of the sinners, so that I may rise up freed by Thy pardon from the bonds of Thy displeasure

arabic_text: وَعَتِيقَ صُنْعِكَ مِنْ وَثَاقِ عَدْلِكَ،
transliteration: waʿatīqa su-nʿika min wathāqi ʿadlika
english_text: and released by Thy benefaction from the ties of Thy justice!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ إنْ تَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ يَا إلهِي تَفْعَلْهُ بِمَنْ لاَ يَجْحَدُ اسْتِحْقَاقَ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَلاَ يُبَرِّئُ نَفْسَهُ مِنِ اسْتِيجَابِ نَقِمَتِكَ،
transliteration: 'innaka 'in taf'al dhalika ya ilahi taf'alhu bi-man lā yajhadu istiḥqāqa ʿuqūbatika wa lā yubarri'u nafsahu min istijāb naqimatak
english_text: Surely if Thou dost that, my God, Thou wilt do it to one who does not deny deserving Thy punishment or acquit himself from merit for Thy vengeance.

arabic_text: تَفْعَلُ ذلِكَ يَا إلهِي بِمَنْ خَوْفُهُ مِنْكَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ طَمَعِهِ فِيكَ، وَبِمَنْ يَأْسُهُ مِنَ النَّجَاةِ أَوْكَدُ مِنْ رَجَائِهِ لِلْخَلاَصِ،
transliteration: tafʿalu dhalika yā ilahī biman khawfuhu minka aktharu min tamaʿihi fīk wa biman yasuhu minan najati awkadu min rajaihi lil-khalas
english_text: Do that, my God, for one whose fear of Thee is greater than his craving from Thee, whose hopelessness of deliverance is firmer than his hope for salvation!

arabic_text: لاَ أَنْ يَكُونَ يَأْسُهُ قُنُوطَاً أَوْ أَنْ يَكُونَ طَمَعُهُ اغْتِرَاراً
transliteration: lā ʾan yakūna yaʾsuhu qunūṭān aw ʾan yakūna ṭamahu ightirāran
english_text: Not that his hopelessness is despair, nor that his expectation is deluded.

arabic_text: بَلْ لِقِلَّةِ حَسَنَاتِهِ بَيْنَ سَيِّئاتِهِ، وَضَعْفِ حُجَجِهِ فِي جَمِيعِ تَبِعَاتِهِ،
transliteration: bal liqillati hasanatihi bayna sayyi'atih waḍaʿfi ḥujajihi fī jamiʿi tabiʿātihi
english_text: No, rather his good deeds are few among his evil deeds and his arguments are frail in face of everything due from his acts.

arabic_text: فَأَمَّا أَنْتَ يَا إلهِي فَأَهْلٌ أَنْ لاَ يَغْتَرَّ بِكَ الصِّدِّيقُونَ، وَلاَ يَيْأَسَ مِنْكَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ، لاَِنَّكَ ألرَّبُّ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِيْ لاَ يَمْنَعُ أَحَداً فَضْلَهُ
transliteration: fa'amman anta ya ilahi fa'ahlun an lā yaghṭarr bika ṣ-ṣid-dīqūn walā yaiʾasa minka al-mujrimūn lānaka al-rabbu al-ʿaẓīmu alladhī lā yamnaʿu aḥadan faḍlahu
english_text: But Thou, my God, art worthy that the righteous not be deluded concerning Thee and the sinners not lose hope in Thee, for Thou art the All-mighty Lord who holds back His bounty from none

arabic_text: وَلاَ يَسْتَقْصِي مِنْ أَحَد حَقَّـهُ.
transliteration: wa lā yastaqsī min aḥad ḥaqquh
english_text: and takes His full right from no one.

arabic_text: تَعَالى ذِكْرُكَ عَنِ الْمَذْكُورِينَ،
transliteration: taʿālá dhikruka ʿani al-madhdhūrīn
english_text: High exalted is Thy mention above those mentioned!

arabic_text: وَتَقَدَّست أَسْمَاؤُكَ عَنِ الْمَنْسُوبِينَ،
transliteration: wataqaddast asmā'uka 'anil-mansūbīn
english_text: Holy are Thy names beyond those described!

arabic_text: وَفَشَتْ نِعْمَتُكَ فِيْ جَمِيْعِ الْمَخْلُوقِينَ،
transliteration: wa fashat niʿmatuka fī jamiʿ al-makhlooqeen
english_text: Spread is Thy favour among all creatures!

arabic_text: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ .
transliteration: falaka al-ḥamdu ʿalā dhālika yā rabba al-ʿālamīn
english_text: Thine is the praise for that, O Lord of the worlds!
